# Watch-ZbxItem

## SYNOPSIS

Watches items and collects every value they report, in the background.

## SYNTAX

### Every (Default)

```
Watch-ZbxItem [-Name] <string> [-Interval <TimeSpan>] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### Host

```
Watch-ZbxItem [-Name] <string> [-HostName] <string> [[-Key] <string>] [-Interval <TimeSpan>] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### Group

```
Watch-ZbxItem [-Name] <string> -Group <string> [-Interval <TimeSpan>] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Watch-ZbxItem cmdlet starts a watch: a session of this runspace that reads, every -Interval, the values the items in its scope collected since the last read, and keeps the newest value of each. The scope is one item (-HostName and -Key), a host's items (-HostName), a host group's items (-Group), or every host. Receive-ZbxWatch reads the values as they arrive, Show-ZbxWatch draws the current ones as a table, and Stop-ZbxWatch ends the watch; it writes the watch only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Watch one item and read its values as they arrive

```powershell
Watch-ZbxItem -Name 'items' -HostName 'web-01' -Key 'zabbix[host,,items]' -Interval '2s'
Receive-ZbxWatch -Name 'items' | Select-Object -First 1 | Select-Object Host, Key, Value
Stop-ZbxWatch -Name 'items'
```

-Interval takes Zabbix's time suffixes ('2s', '1m'), seconds or a time span; the watch reads every two seconds and Receive-ZbxWatch writes each new value until Select-Object -First ends it.

### Example 2: Watch every item of a host group

```powershell
Watch-ZbxItem -Name 'linux' -Group 'Linux servers' -Interval '30s' -PassThru | Select-Object Name, Started
Stop-ZbxWatch -Name 'linux'
```

-Group watches each item of each host in the group; -PassThru writes the watch.

## INPUTS

None.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixWatch`: Represents a running IZabbixWatcher, kept in the runspace's Sessions by name: started by Watch-ZbxItem, found by Get-ZbxWatch, read by Receive-ZbxWatch, stopped by Stop-ZbxWatch — or when the runspace closes.
